scope: Three human content-writing conventions; no native meanings, raw target/source counts, images, new sources, encoders, phonological-class/harmony review or root-owned file changes.
decision: All three potentially useful mechanisms are already represented. Preserve their distinct teaching value and their actual later stops; do not manufacture a new RAW card by renaming their fields. None presently supplies a selected full 22-working-sign open-text writer.

candidates.mechanism: A common fraction bar makes components share a directed denominator scope.
candidates.historical_evidence: Existing source collation of Fibonacci, Liber abbaci, Boncompagni1857 printed24-25. The source explicitly distinguishes a common bar, separate bars and additional differently marked constructions. The existing report viewed the original edition pages; this block only read that report.
candidates.human_use: Write the numerators above their denominators and draw one continuous bar when the fractions are parts of parts. A separate bar closes that dependency. Read the ordinary common-bar row from the right: each step to the left adds its numerator divided by its own denominator and every denominator to its right. A single a/b cell writes an arbitrary positive rational quantity without a whole-quantity dictionary.
candidates.hand_example: The attested two cells (1,2),(4,7) under one bar mean 4/7 + 1/(2*7) = 9/14. Under separate bars they mean 1/2 + 4/7 = 15/14. A reversed nesting direction instead gives 11/14. These reduced results are the old report's derived arithmetic, not claimed printed result numerals.
candidates.synthetic_repeat_example: Let B be the ordinary fraction cell (1,2), purely in this teaching example. B has value1/2. Two B cells under one common bar have value1/2 + 1/4 =3/4; two separate B bars have summed value1. Thus B and BB can have completely determined different contents without an independent whole-BB dictionary entry. This example is generated from the declared source rule, not an additional historical specimen and not an assignment to ol or any native form.
candidates.small_complete_utterance: Invented ordinary-language command: Take [two cells (1,2),(1,2) under one common bar] beaker of water. The bracketed quantity means3/4 beaker. The verb, unit and material still have their ordinary separately learned words; the fraction rule does not covertly encode the entire command.
candidates.paid_costs: Learn decimal numeral writing, numerator/denominator placement, one scope convention and its direction, and elementary fractions. Pay visible bar extent, two-row alignment, all digits, units, operation words and material names. To write a compound rather than a single reduced fraction, its stated decomposition or a fixed canonical choice must be part of the input contract; arbitrary alternative fraction spellings cannot be selected after seeing target statistics. Unknown ordinary names still require full conventional spelling. A linear 22-sign serialization is not supplied by this 2D lesson.
candidates.counterexample: In the attested cells (1,2),(0,7), the zero-numerator second cell retains the7 denominator, so the value is1/14. Removing that apparently empty cell gives1/2. Blank-looking or zero-bearing structure is not free padding.
prior_limits: GDT882_REPORT excludes a nonzero fixed additive whole-line invariant under its declared literal units; this nonlinear scoped notation does not satisfy that premise. The difference is not affirmative manuscript evidence.
GDT882 lookup followups include883,885 and903. None is claimed superseded, and no old suggested continuation is adopted.
IDEA358 already treats multiplication/reduction path equivalence;386 concerns written denominator scope. No duplicate card is needed.

GDT1201 permits transparent alternative parses with identical total message. Its transparent-concatenation construction is not a universal rule that every conceivable semantic composition must be additive or invariant when its scope changes.

The rule does not identify native numerals, entry variants, glyph atoms, spacing or a source arithmetic assertion. Assigning an arbitrary rational value to every whole native group would remove the discriminating constraint.
candidates.selection: Retain as a concrete historical model of small productive scope rules. No numeral trial or full-text writer selected.

candidates.mechanism: Use separate ordinary constructions for naming identity, guarded replacement and actual membership.
candidates.historical_evidence: The existing British Library catalogue for Egerton747 supplies recipe, substitution and synonym sections. This establishes the functions' coexistence, not a securely collated linked three-relation example.
candidates.later_stop: NO_SECURE_FIRST_SUBSTITUTION_PAIR: the preselected first entry did not securely identify two different named materials; the next entry was not substituted for it. Do not sell a catalogue description as an observed complete substitution chain.
invented_hand_example: If Mira is unavailable, use Sela instead of Mira.
Preparation R contains Nera and Tava.
candidates.manual_reading: The third sentence ordinarily selects Mira's material and Tava. Under the second sentence's written unavailability guard, Sela replaces that material and Tava remains. Sela is not thereby a synonym of Mira, and the output does not contain both Mira and Sela merely because both are mentioned. A later statement that Sela may be replaced by Vena would not on its own license replacing Mira directly by Vena.
candidates.paid_costs: A reader learns the ordinary nouns and names, three relation constructions, an explicit conditional boundary and which argument is replaced. All participating names, guard words and unchanged ingredients are actually written. This is ordinary lexical learning, not three glyphs standing for three unwritten complete paragraphs. General negation, quantities, instructions and open-name spelling would still need their own full writer contract; no physical 22-sign carrier is supplied.
candidates.counterexample: Replacing conditional substitution by undirected co-occurrence loses whether one or both ingredients are used. Absence from an open list cannot supply an explicit prohibition; name identity cannot be inferred from recipe similarity.
prior_limits: IDEA707 already owns local obligatory-ingredient versus permitted-substitute contrast;910 adds joint naming identity across records.
GDT1159 failed fixed anonymous ingredient-graph recovery. The new relation names do not repair its numeric model or identify any ingredient.
GDT1031 synonym-recurrence shortening ended NO_CAPACITY, not a synonym confirmation or general refutation. Its guessed synonym sets remain unavailable as lexical facts.
REMEDY_COMPLAINT_CONSTRUCTION_REVIEW.md additionally distinguishes910 from converse indexing916 and warns against merely relabelling old complete symbolic accounts.
candidates.selection: Existing RAW content construction; the crucial guarded contrast is concrete and understandable, but not a complete new writer or a selected native relation test.

candidates.mechanism: A learned grammatical nominalization names the bearer of a condition while preserving the recipient of a following instruction.
candidates.historical_evidence: The existing complete Adrianum source transcription in Antidotarium Sangallense mixes recipient-class nominals and relative clauses. The card retains the scope uncertainty and the distinction between a base preparation and a carrier or additional branch ingredient.
candidates.human_use: An ordinary speaker can write a person-bearing-P as a compact nominal instead of repeating the whole relative clause. The rest of the sentence still supplies the instruction and its arguments; the nominal does not encode that entire sentence. The English hand example below demonstrates reduction to a modifier plus retained noun, not a newly attested single-word nominalizer.
candidates.invented_hand_example: Give the tag to the worker who is waiting becomes Give the tag to the waiting worker. Both identify the same recipient under the declared waiting condition. In contrast, Give the tag to the worker who is not waiting retains NOT inside that relative condition; not-worker or not-give would be different scopes.
candidates.paid_costs: Learn the source language's productive morphology and lexical exceptions, the recipient argument, modifier attachment and visible sentence boundaries. Open predicates or names must be spelled, and a language without the required productive nominal form needs the full clause. A general suffix cannot be presumed to nominalize every predicate or to preserve every quantifier/tense contrast.
candidates.later_stop: The actual inherited local draft contributes P(x) AND P(x), so swapping nominal and predicate roles changes no continuation. Its other three predicate contributions lack a bound recipient. The strict immediate-negation extension fails because the written follower is not the licensed predicate family. This exact construction has been considered, not merely waiting unexecuted in RAW.
candidates.counterexample: A positive nominal and a redundant same-condition clause do not discriminate role direction; a negative condition must change the licensed recipient/continuation with its own written scope. A nearest-looking suffix or a freshly named intervening word cannot supply that contrast.
candidates.prior_limits: GDT1163's fixed two-receptive-arguments failure, GDT916's new-stem nontransfer and the explicit920 extension stop remain. This is not a repair of952's agreement language or951's single-statement carrier.
candidates.selection: Retain the historical grammatical lesson. Do not renominate the already reviewed920 packet or manufacture a new nominalization card.

comparison_conclusion: These cases distinguish a numeric scope rule, a typed relation language and a lexical grammatical transformation. Each offers meaningful human operations with limited extra rules, but each relies on already learned vocabulary or explicit numeric conventions. No learned vocabulary is declared cost-free, and no small structural rule by itself supplies an alphabet, full open-word spelling or a historical language. Existing diversity is sufficient; the next decision should turn on a fully specified contract rather than a new label for one of these modules.
validation: Manual primary/source reasoning only; JSON syntax check is administrative. No own measurement, scoring, proof program, decoder or source text encoding.
